progression.narrative: The performance opens on D5 and dwells most on D in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:09.5) introduces G, Bb, D, centred on D. Phrase 3 (0:19.7) introduces Ak, centred on C. Phrase 6 (1:06.2) introduces F, centred on G. Phrase 8 (1:44.2) introduces Ek, centred on Bb. The line peaks at C6 (1065.7 Hz) at 0:28.0. It closes on the tonic (G3 → G3 → G3 → G3 → G4 → G3).
